ValidationRule.description: A Data Lake Object (__dll) needs its Ingestion API connector, object and primary key, and a WHERE clause: it has no default delete logic.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RIGHT(LOWER(SObjectApiName__c), 5) = '__dll', OR( ISBLANK(IngestionConnector__c), ISBLANK(IngestionObject__c), ISBLANK(PrimaryKeyField__c), ISBLANK(WhereClauseToBeDeleted__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Data Lake Object (__dll) needs IngestionConnector__c, IngestionObject__c, PrimaryKeyField__c and a WhereClauseToBeDeleted__c in Data 360 SQL.
